Hand crank electric openers are a bit difficult to use with arthritis and other ailments that plague the hand. Given the fact that I have arthritis, and a bit of carpal tunnel, I decided to try this electric wine opener.

First off, it completely eliminates the need for any force from the hands. Simply align the corkscrew tip to the center of the bottle, press down and hold the bottle in place, press the lower button and let the opener do all the work for you. This was an amenity I never knew I needed!

Now that said, I’ve posted a video of this item in action…Even with 4 new AA batteries, the opener struggles a bit as it’s retracting to pull the cork out. Listen carefully to the motor as the corkscrew enters the cork, then as the opener begins to extract the cork from the bottle. It was expected there would be some pause, but the first couple of times I used this thing, my thoughts were that it might get stuck during the extraction portion.
Overall, this electric wine opener works as designed, and based on that I’m giving 5 stars, however, I’ll be monitoring the power during continued use and will edit my review accordingly.
